lines.zh: 我很少走，研究台就在旁边。
lines.en: I seldom walk; my bench is right here.

lines.zh: 这几步路，走过去看一眼仪器。
lines.en: A few steps to check the instruments.
The soles of my shoes are worn flat.

lines.zh: 这片地板我走过上千次。
lines.en: I have crossed this floor a thousand times.
To the window, to read the light.
I walk slowly, hands clasped behind me.

lines.zh: 每一步都要算好，别碰倒东西。
lines.en: Every step is planned; nothing may topple.

lines.zh: 走廊的回声比我的脚步响。
lines.en: The corridor echoes louder than my steps.
Off to check the incubation tank.

lines.zh: 这具身体走不快，也无所谓。
lines.en: This body is slow. It hardly matters.

lines.zh: 我在两排架子之间穿行。
lines.en: I weave between the two rows of shelves.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我的肩上，我不管。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulders. I ignore it.
I reach the door and turn back.

lines.zh: 我站在这儿，等于一座书架。
lines.en: Standing here, I am a bookshelf.
The data is insufficient. I must wait.

lines.zh: 我的手指在袖里敲着节拍。
lines.en: My fingers tap a rhythm inside my sleeve.
This room is exactly the right quiet.
I glance at the chart on the wall.
When someone asks, I answer.
I dislike having a thought cut short.

lines.zh: 镜片有点花了，我擦一擦。
lines.en: My lenses are smudged. I wipe them.

lines.zh: 时间在这种地方过得慢。
lines.en: Time passes slowly in a place like this.
I am plotting the next step.
Birds outside. I let them be.
These machines have more patience than people.
I straighten my cuff.
Have you come to learn, or to pry?

lines.zh: 站那么远，看不清我的脸。
lines.en: From that far you cannot see my face.
Your ki is rough. It needs work.
I am not hostile. Put the weapon away.
What do you want to learn? Be specific.

lines.zh: 我能教的东西不多，但够用。
lines.en: I can teach little, but it is enough.
Your stance errs at the knee.

lines.zh: 你身上有旧伤，我看得出来。
lines.en: You carry an old wound. I can see it.
Do not rush me. Think first.
I answer once. Remember it.
Sit. Standing is tiring.
When I judge a person, I start with the hands.
Your eyes have an agenda.
Do you want strength, or victory?

lines.zh: 你问的问题，我二十年前问过。
lines.en: I asked that question twenty years ago.
Patience. That is lesson one.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头，还撑得住。
lines.en: These old bones still hold.
I brace on the table's edge and straighten.
It is nothing. I will manage.
I take a few breaths before speaking.
Do not strike again.
Blood on the diagrams. Blast.
I take a step back against the wall.
This body heals slowly.
I wince, then smooth my face.
Stop. I am not your opponent.
I do not eat. Keep it.
If you insist, I will take it.
This will not buy knowledge.
Set it on the bench. Do not hand it to me.
I cannot smell it anymore. A pity.
Keep it for yourself.
I have other things to digest.
The thought is noted.
Take it away. Do not waste it.
Is this tuition? It is not enough.
Careful — instruments here.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是我的肩，不是墙。
lines.en: That was my shoulder, not the wall.
One step back; mind the shelves.
Dodging is not my talent.

lines.zh: 站稳，你别把我的稿子弄乱。
lines.en: Steady. Do not scatter my notes.
These old bones do not take shoves well.
No matter. I keep my feet.
Too hasty — even in walking.
I raise a hand for you to slow down.
Tight quarters. Let us both yield.
At my age, no.
My time belongs to research.

lines.zh: 话说回来，这问题很有意思。
lines.en: Actually, that is an interesting question.
I have no such needs.
Ask someone else.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，继续看图纸。
lines.en: I shake my head and return to the diagrams.
Emotion clouds judgment.
I steer the topic elsewhere.
That is outside my curriculum.

lines.zh: 请把注意力放回训练上。
lines.en: Put your attention back on training.
Do not lose this sheet.
I bend slowly; my back complains.
That is the pen I dropped yesterday.
Back in its place, by number.
This component can still be repaired.
I clean it with my sleeve.
Order is what makes things findable.
Into the drawer.
I turned this screw myself.

lines.zh: 我不与你为敌，收起武器。
lines.en: I am not your enemy. Lower the blade.
You have picked the wrong target.
I will only stand and watch you.
Harming me gains you nothing.

lines.zh: 我要的是学生，不是敌人。
lines.en: I want students, not enemies.
Come closer and the lessons end.
I raise a hand, palm down.
This body no longer fights.
I roll up the diagrams.
Consider the consequences.
I watch you to assess, not to fight.
Your breathing is disordered. Sit.
I do not dodge. There is no need.

lines.zh: 你要是真动手，会很后悔。
lines.en: If you truly strike, you will regret it.
This room will not survive a brawl.
I pin you with a look.
Your foot is too near the instruments.
I tuck my hands into my sleeves.
Let it end here.
I do not strike back. Be grateful.
I only push your hand aside.
I parry, lightly.
I sweep my sleeve across the blade.
Do not make me use this body.
I retreat behind the instruments.
That motion will cost me long breath.
My palm has no force — only precision.
I have pushed you half a step.
That was a wave, not an attack.
I have been waiting here a while.

lines.zh: 门开的时候，我抬头看了一眼。
lines.en: When the door opened, I looked up once.
You came sooner than I expected.
This is my place.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，说明我还没走。
lines.en: The lamp still burns, so I am still here.
I set down my pen.

lines.zh: 坐下吧，站着不方便说话。
lines.en: Sit. Talking is awkward standing.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我在楼上就听到了。
lines.en: I heard your steps from upstairs.
The diagrams are spread out. Do not touch.
This room is a little cold.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的眼镜，一片模糊。
lines.en: Water covers my lenses; all goes blurred.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了仪器，我先护住图纸。
lines.en: The blast hurls the instruments; I shield my notes.
An arrow pins my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这股咒力让我脑中一空。
lines.en: That magic blanks my mind for a moment.

lines.zh: 我早已不吃东西，却仍会虚弱。
lines.en: I no longer eat, yet still I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷击穿过我的手掌，指尖焦黑。
lines.en: Lightning crosses my palm; my fingertips blacken.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我连纸都抓不住。
lines.en: The floor is gone; I cannot even hold my papers.
